description: The core v3 test. A memo carrying durable, athlete-stated facts (a night-shift constraint, a Saturday long-run preference, two kids at home). v3 must emit memory_candidates with the right closed-vocab categories (constraint/preference/life), in the athlete's own framing — never inferred psychology, never health speculation. This is the row the memory writer dedups-or-reinforces into user_memories.
